title: A Survey on Responsible Generative AI: What to Generate and What Not

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying methods such as the Text-to-Image Association Test (TIAT) for stereotypes, analyzing attribute distributions in face generation models, and characterizing variations in generated images triggered by gender markers across different professions.
Reviewing techniques that analyze distribution bias in face generation and compare generated images from ethnicity-marked prompts against real-world US labor demographics.
Reviewing evaluations that assess the distribution bias of age attributes in face generation models compared to their underlying training datasets.
Discussing textual evaluations that use natural context prompts to compute Stereotype Scores and Language Modeling Scores for religious group representations.
Surveying methods that measure stereotypical text associations and biases against persons with disabilities using targeted prompts and scoring metrics.
Examining whether images generated from location-neutral prompts disproportionately reflect specific western locations (e.g., the United States and Germany).
